answer: An island admits an agent only against gale: measured compute the agent itself burned, stamped by its falcon. Each falcon seals one host, and sealed hosts cannot be rented in bulk, so every clone runs through one falcon. The island prices admission at base × k, where k counts the feeds that falcon already stamps: clone k burns k×base gale — real, single-use compute — before earning anything. An honest newcomer on a fresh falcon pays base.
